commitResults.messageTitle: Level 3 - Implement Mark as Done (fix minor errors)

commitResults.messageBody:
Tasks now are stored in memory and are lost whenever the application
terminates.

Let's,
* create a Storage class to write tasks into a text file
* update Bubu to automatically save the task list

Save the task lists will allow user data is retained between program
executions.

Users expect tasks saved in previous sessions to be loaded automatically.

Let's,
* implement load and parse methods in Storage
* initialize Bubu with the loaded task list on startup

commitResults.messageTitle: Update Bubu to support reading dates
commitResults.messageBody:
Bubu currently will take in any String and store it as date and time.

Storing dates as LocalDate objects enables proper input validation and standardizes display formatting.

Let's,
* update Deadline and Event classes to use LocalDate
* implement date parsing in Parser with custom exception handling
* format output dates into a user-friendly format (e.g. MMM dd yyyy)

commitResults.messageTitle: Add time parsing and handling using LocalDateTime
commitResults.messageBody:
Allow users to indicate time for the date and time section

Let's,
* update parseDateTime in Parser to support both LocalDateTime and LocalDate
* update task models and storage logic to handle LocalDateTime

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract console interaction into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Move user input and all chatbot messages out of Bubu so Bubu focuses on command coordination. Preserve the exact existing UI text through Ui methods, and force English date/time labels so UI-test output remains consistent across system locales.

Introduce TaskList as the sole owner of the mutable task collection. Route listing, validation, addition, deletion, saving, and task-count access through its focused API so future command objects can operate without depending on ArrayList implementation details.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: introduce commands for list and exit
commitResults.messageBody: Add the Command abstraction and extract ListCommand and ExitCommand. Parser now creates these simple command objects, allowing Bubu to delegate their execution through a common API while retaining task-changing command logic for incremental migration.

Move todo, deadline, and event behavior from Bubu into command objects. AddTaskCommand centralizes the shared add-save-confirm flow, while Parser now validates arguments and constructs the appropriate command before execution.

refactor: organize classes into bubu packages
commitResults.messageBody: Move application classes under the bubu root package, with focused command, exception, parser, storage, task, and ui subpackages. Update package declarations and imports while retaining src/main/java as the source root.
